M1.expectation_recorded: the matched set will shrink, because most alleles are host-restricted. A wider interval is expected and is not evidence against the effect
M1.name: exact symbol, no collapsing
M1.rule: repeat the matched contrast using the raw `Element symbol` as the matching unit, with the registered eligibility rule (>=3 species, >=10 BioProjects, >=20 occurrences, class B observable) applied to symbols instead of families

M2.name: exact symbol, lineage-adjusted
M2.rule: M1 with one genome per sequence type, so the two corrections the review asks for are seen together rather than one at a time

R1.estimator: DerSimonian-Laird on the Woolf log odds ratios with the Haldane-Anscombe 0.5 correction, 95% Wald interval
R1.name: random-effects pooling of the family-matched contrast
R1.reported_with: I2 and the fixed-effect Mantel-Haenszel estimate, always together, never one without the other

R2.name: random-effects pooling after lineage adjustment
R2.rule: R1 applied to the one-genome-per-sequence-type cohort

decision_rule.fails: if M1 loses direction or covers 1, the effect depends on the collapsing rule and the claim is rewritten to say so
decision_rule.no_threshold_may_move: these criteria may not be changed after any arm is run
decision_rule.random_effects_rule: wherever the fixed-effect pooled odds ratio appears in the manuscript, the random-effects estimate and I2 appear with it. This is a reporting rule, not a significance test, and it applies whichever is larger
decision_rule.reported_regardless: all four arms are reported whatever they show
decision_rule.survives: the claim that a matched determinant occupies different portability routes across hosts survives if M1 and M2 keep direction with a 95% interval excluding 1

known_limits: at exact-symbol resolution the eligibility rule bites much harder, so M1 measures a different and smaller set of determinants than the family analysis; it is a robustness check on the matching unit, not a replacement estimand
DerSimonian-Laird is a moment estimator and is known to underestimate between-study variance when the number of strata is small
this amendment covers the matched contrast only

matching_unit.as_used: gene family, derived from the AMRFinderPlus `Element symbol` by stripping a trailing allele designator at the last hyphen when that tail matches ^(?:\d+[A-Za-z'"]*|[IVX]+[a-z]?|[A-Za-z]{1,3})$
matching_unit.why_it_exists: the question is whether the same determinant occupies different routes in different hosts. At allele resolution most alleles occur in one host only, and there is nothing to match.
matching_unit.why_it_must_be_tested: collapsing alleles could merge determinants with genuinely different mobility - blaOXA-51-like is chromosomal and blaOXA-23 is transposon-borne, and the rule puts both in blaOXA

raised_by: final review: the gene-family definition is undocumented and derived by regular expression rather than from the AMRFinderPlus family field; and a fixed-effect pooled estimate is reported at I2 = 83.63% without a random-effects companion
title: Matching-unit sensitivity and random-effects reporting
